q1.sampleAnswer: The cards in Kawara have the faces of real local people, not cartoon characters or superheroes.

keyPoints.descZh: 卡片上是真实的当地人，不是卡通人物或超级英雄
examples: The cards have the faces of real local people.
They are not cartoon characters or superheroes.

q1.rubricZh: 要点：卡片上是真人（当地人），不是卡通人物/超级英雄。
q1.explanationZh: 第二段说别的孩子的卡片是卡通人物，但香春町孩子的卡片上是真实的人。

evidence.quote: The faces on their cards belong to real people.

q2.sampleAnswer: Because they are ordinary local middle-aged men, not traditional or famous heroes.

keyPoints.descZh: 他们是普通的本地中年男人，不是传统意义上的或有名的英雄
examples: They are ordinary local middle-aged men.
They are not traditional or famous heroes.

q2.rubricZh: 要点：他们是普通的当地中年人，不是传统/著名的英雄。
q2.explanationZh: 这几个人是火车司机、退休专家、町长，都是普通的本地人，不像传统英雄，所以成为英雄让人意外。

evidence.quote: There’s Hiroyuki Fukushima, a local train driver.

q3.sampleAnswer: The real-world achievements of the ojisan.

keyPoints.descZh: 大叔在现实中的成就（做志愿工作、社区服务的多少）
examples: How much volunteer work or community service he does.

q3.rubricZh: 要点：大叔现实中的成就（志愿工作/社区服务）。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说卡的稀有度不是随机的，而是看大叔现实中的成就，做的志愿和社区服务越多，魔法点越高。

evidence.quote: Rather, it’s based on the ojisan’s real-world achievements.

q4.sampleAnswer: I think the creators could make the game even better and more popular by introducing trading cards featuring some amazing local women. Many women also play important roles in their families and communities.(Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 提出合理的改进建议（如加入当地女性的卡片），言之有理即可
examples: Introduce cards featuring amazing local women.
Hold events where kids can meet the people on the cards.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：提出一条合理的改进办法并说明理由。答案不唯一。
q4.explanationZh: 这是开放题，可以从卡片内容、活动或玩法上提建议，比如加入有贡献的当地女性，因为她们也在家庭和社区中发挥重要作用。

evidence.quote: Some of them are now eager to volunteer for community activities.
